text:
morgan: Heads-up — customer cohort A seeing duplicated suggestions in streaming completions after the v1.4 rollout. small sample but consistent across 3 sessions. need to decide triage path: rollback, a fast patch, or UX mitigation (dedupe client-side).
li: ugh. do we have a repro & logs? which model/variant? :eyes:
devin: model: opt-6.7b-quant, seq len ~512, appears on short prompts only. no full repro yet. I saw a partial trace in staging that looked like duplicated token emission on the first response chunk.
sara: can we quantify customer impact? is it a breakage or just noisy?
morgan: noisy UX — suggestions repeated, annoying but not incorrect. customer reported twice during demo so high visibility. impact: user confusion & perceived flakiness.
li: priority-wise, this should be medium-high for cohort A. if rollout is small we can pause expansion. thoughts on rollout freeze?
devin: agree pause expansion. quick triage plan: (1) capture streaming payloads from affected hosts, (2) try to repro with higher debug logging in staging, (3) try a quick server-side guard that drops immediate repeated tokens within a short window.
sara: timeline? customer is on Monday demo. can we do a canary rollback to previous model snapshot (v1.3) tonight and see?
morgan: rollback is safe but loses some perf wins. alternative is short-term UX dedupe at client side (easy), shipping server guard (fast, maybe risky), or rollback.
li: can we run an A/B on 10% vs 90%? route cohort A to v1.3 and keep 90% on v1.4, collect metrics for 24 hrs.
devin: I can wire routing rule and temporary guard. will need a quick deploy. @deploy-bot can you annotate current deployment and open a canary?
deploy-bot: deploy-notice: v1.4 deployed to prod at 1759080000 by release-ci. Canary can be created: instruction: `redwood deploy canary --from v1.3 --to cohortA --percent 10`
sara: nice. if devin can create the rule + guard today we should be good. who owns customer comms?
morgan: I will notify customer of a targeted test and offer workaround (client-side dedupe snippet).
devin: plan: 1) create routing rule for cohort A -> v1.3 (10%) 2) add server guard that suppresses repeated token emissions within 500ms window 3) add verbose streaming logs on canary hosts 4) run for 24 hrs, collect `dup_token_rate`, `p99_latency`, `error_rate`
li: add a console dashboard slice for `dup_token_rate` and link to the ticket.
morgan: created ticket INF-3421 and assigned to devin. attaching quick client snippet as workaround:
```
// client dedupe: drop suggestions identical to previous within 1s window
let last = '';
function dedupe(s){ if (s === last) return null; last = s; return s; }
```
sara: we should also update launch criteria checklist: streaming reg checks + a small prompt bank for dedupe regression.
devin: will run repro with that prompt bank in staging; if repro consistent I'll push server guard to canary by EOD.
morgan: thanks. li, can you shepherd the A/B and dashboard?
li: on it. will create the dashboard and set alerts at dup_token_rate > 0.5% :eyeglasses: (and ping on pager if >1%).
sara: follow-up milestone: decide by Tue 09:00 whether to fully rollback or keep v1.4 with guard. add to roadmap micro-release list.
morgan: noted. quick summary: pause expansion for cohort A, canary route 10% to v1.3, push guard + logs to canary, run 24h, review Tue 09:00. owner: devin. comms owner: morgan.
devin: starting now. will post updates in this thread with timestamps.
li: dashboard pr opened: https://console.redwood/boards/INF-3421 (will add shares to product channel).
morgan: thanks team. :thumbsup:
(reacts: :shipit: from sara)
